title: Require Service Context Boundaries
forbids: a missing or duplicate exported Context owner, runtime imports or exports in context.ts, context aggregation from outside owned model/ports leaves, or a module implementation reopening the root Context owner
why: The pinned E2 service has one private context and port aggregation owner. Configured module branches carry that vocabulary to handlers without public deep imports or a second context cabinet.
remediate: Export the sole Context type from service/context.ts, aggregate only type imports from root or module model/ports leaves, and let configured service module branches infer handler context.
message: Service context and ports must have one private aggregation owner.
